stages.title: Every idea has a stage
stages.click: Click a stage to show only the ideas at that stage.
stages.tap: Tap a stage to show only the ideas at that stage.
stages.parked: Parked ideas keep their scores and live under Parked in the menu.

potential.title: Potential: five scores, averaged
potential.each: Each is a value of 1 to 5. Profitability can also be 0, for something deliberately non-commercial.
potential.hidden: The five scores stay out of this table by default. Tick {{showScores}} below it to see them, and hover any column heading to see what its numbers mean.
potential.colour: The colour says which band a number falls in:

confidence.title: Confidence: how much evidence is behind those scores?
confidence.starts: Every new idea starts at 1. Desk research can take it to 2; only recorded conversations take it further. Three rules for those conversations:
confidence.receipts: The evidence log on each idea keeps the receipts. {{gate}}

score.title: Score is what ranks your ideas
score.cap: Score can never exceed Potential. The most evidence in the world only proves the idea is as good as you thought.

open.title: Click an idea to score it
open.text: This table is for comparing. Scoring happens inside an idea, where each number shows its meaning as you pick, and where the evidence log lives.
open.replay: You can replay this tour any time from Help, under Show me around.

phone.cardText: The number in the corner is its Score, which is what ranks your ideas. Below the name: its stage, its Potential and its Confidence.
